title: Manyhands JSON v1 history resolution mutation data
description: The data of an item resolve-history or remote resolve-history envelope: the context is recorded as never published (item sync is what publishes it), and whether that cleared the repository-wide cache-loss flag.

cache_loss_cleared.description: Whether this resolution cleared the cache-loss flag: the last context that read unknown was resolved, or remote resolve-history found none.

marker.description: What became of the cache-loss marker file once the flag was cleared: not_applicable when it was not cleared, removed, absent when there was no file, and failed when it could not be deleted (the resolution stands).
